translations.web: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
translations.bsb: The princes of Judah are like those who move boundary stones; I will pour out My fury upon them like water.
translations.kjv: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
translations.asv: The princes of Judah are like them that remove the landmark: I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
